# Reva Designs Server – Copilot Instructions

Express 4 + Mongoose 7 (MongoDB) REST API (CommonJS, no TypeScript, no tests) for the Reva Designs Indian ethnic-wear e-commerce store. Its only consumer is the sibling React app at `../reva_designs_frontend-main`.

Source code is the source of truth. Context docs in `.github/context/` are verified summaries; if they conflict with code, trust the code and fix the doc.

## Context routing (read before editing)

| Task | Read |
|---|---|
| "What is this system?" | `context/PROJECT_DNA.md` |
| Architecture, layers, request lifecycle | `context/ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| Add/change route, model, middleware, controller | `context/BACKEND.md` |
| Entities, statuses, business rules | `context/BUSINESS_DOMAIN.md` |
| Frontend contract, response shapes, flows | `context/API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md` |
| Tests / validation | `context/TESTING.md` |
| Conventions, commands, anti-patterns | `context/WORKFLOW.md` |
| Why something is the way it is | `context/DECISION_LOG.md` |
| Recent work / open issues | `context/SESSION_JOURNAL.md` |

Multi-area tasks: read the combination. Example: new entity field -> `BACKEND.md` + `API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md` + the frontend project's `.github/context/API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md`.

## Always follow

1. Search before creating. Entity CRUD is generated by `controllers/genericController.js` factories; do not write per-entity controllers unless behavior truly differs.
2. Match existing patterns: CommonJS `require`, one model file + one `routes/<entity>Routes.js` per entity, swagger JSDoc block above each route group, `{ collection: '<Name>', timestamps: true }` on every schema.
3. Protect the API contract. Paths `/entities/<Entity>` and `/auth/*`, field names (snake_case), and response shapes are consumed by `../reva_designs_frontend-main/src/api/base44Client.js`. Check consumers before changing them.
4. Never invent schema fields, collections, or behavior. Verify in `models/`.
5. Never print or commit secrets. There is no `.env` in the repo (gitignored); required vars: `MONGODB_URI`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT`, `NODE_ENV`.
6. Be aware of the known gaps in `BACKEND.md` ("Known gaps") before assuming auth, filtering or validation exist. Do not silently "fix" them as a side effect of an unrelated task; raise them.
7. Smallest complete change. No unrelated refactors.

## Validate changes

No lint/test/build scripts exist. Minimum: `node --check <file>`, then `npm run dev` and exercise the endpoint (Swagger UI at `/api-docs`, `GET /health`). See `context/TESTING.md`.

## Keeping context current

When a change invalidates a context doc, update that doc in the same change. Durable developer feedback goes to: conventions -> `WORKFLOW.md`, decisions -> `DECISION_LOG.md`, backend patterns -> `BACKEND.md`, business rules -> `BUSINESS_DOMAIN.md`, API behavior -> `API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md`. Keep `SESSION_JOURNAL.md` short.

Items marked `⚠ NEEDS HUMAN VERIFICATION` are unconfirmed; do not treat them as facts.
